summary: Implemented every stub in my files (lexer.py, bccache.py, meta.py; __init__.py and _identifier.py needed no changes), restoring the helpers the skeleton had dropped (_describe_token_type, lstrip_unless_re, FileSystemBytecodeCache._get_default_cache_dir and its load/dump/clear methods, MemcachedBytecodeCache load/dump), and changed one 3.12-only nested-quote f-string in lexer.py to parse on the 3.10 jail interpreter. The last full-suite run gave 801 passed and 50 failed; none of the failures trace to my files, and they come from exceptions.py, compiler.py, ext.py and other builders' in-progress files.
